services_shape: visits of a set length, booked with a heart doctor or a nurse practitioner by name; a new patient's first visit is longer and the owner OKs it; follow-up visits are booked by the office at checkout, never offered by text or to an AI; a heart tracing (ECG) is booked as its own short visit on the heart doctor's order; a house call has a 2-hour arrival window; no same-day sick times: a worry goes to the nurse line first
questions_before_times: a new or a current patient
which visit: the office's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
for a video visit: which state the patient will be in
who the visit is for: the person booking, or another adult
safety_stop: chest pain or pressure, trouble breathing, fainting, a racing or pounding heartbeat with dizziness, signs of a stroke (a drooping face, a weak arm, slurred speech, a sudden severe headache), or very heavy bleeding
an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
first_steps: Health history, medicines, the consent and the privacy notice
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
Records from the last heart doctor
The owner's OK for a new patient
license: the business's own word only: Rosie never requires a license or insurance and never checks one (D96); a clinician's license is for the business to add if it wants it shown; a license the owner says the work needs, and that a person doesn't hold, stops that person's bookings for it
staff_skills: heart doctors and nurse practitioners: new patients, follow-up visits, video follow-ups and house calls; nurses and technicians: heart tracings on the heart doctor's order; home heart tracings: someone the owner has cleared for house calls; only people cleared for house calls go to homes
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, symptoms, medicines, test results or the clinician's name (at a house call the clinician's name stays, for the door check)
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
